intents.description: General questions about Samarthya AI, Saksham, platform mission, and core capabilities.
questions: What is Samarthya AI?
Who created Saksham?
What does this platform do?
Samarthya AI kya hai aur ye kaise kaam karta hai?
Aapka naam kya hai aur aap meri kya madad kar sakte hain?
What happened to Sanjeevani Grid?
Is Saksham free to use for rural citizens?
How does Saksham help daily wage earners and gig workers?
Can I use Saksham without creating an account?
What languages does Saksham support?
intents.response_template: Saksham (powered by Samarthya AI) is an inclusive digital public infrastructure combining AI-driven financial enablement with statutory welfare delivery. It features instant scheme eligibility checks across 28+ government schemes, fair credit readiness scoring without predatory data scraping, and end-to-end voice-guided navigation across 6 Indian languages.

intents.response_template: Saksham matches your socio-economic indicators (landholding, annual household income, occupation, and SECC category) against statutory scheme rules. For PM-KISAN: Small/marginal landowning farmers get ₹6,000/yr in 3 tranches; e-KYC and land seeding are mandatory. For Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY: Families listed in SECC 2011 or NFSA ration card receive ₹5 Lakh annual cashless hospital coverage.

intents.response_template: Saksham evaluates your credit readiness using a transparent, inclusive 300–900 index based on 5 pillars: Cashflow Consistency (30%), Repayment Discipline (25%), Debt-to-Surplus Ratio (20%), Utility/Rent Track Record (15%), and Business Longevity (10%). Checking your score here is a soft inquiry with zero penalty.

intents.response_template: Tap the purple microphone icon in the bottom-right chat window or press Alt+V to start voice mode. Saksham natively processes Indian English, Hindi (हिन्दी), Punjabi (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ), Marathi (मराठी), Tamil (தமிழ்), and Gujarati (ગુજરાતી) using Wispr Flow and local Web Speech APIs. Your raw voice audio stays on your device and is not saved to external storage.

intents.description: Assurances and guidelines regarding personal data protection, Aadhaar masking, and compliance.
questions: Is my Aadhaar number stored on your servers?
Is Saksham compliant with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act 2023)?
Kya mera bank data safe hai?
Does Saksham share my personal details with private loan sharks?
Will Saksham ask for my OTP or bank ATM PIN?
How can I delete my entered details from Saksham?
Can I use Saksham anonymously without giving my phone number?
Who can see my credit readiness report?
Where are my documents stored when I upload a ration card?
Does Saksham run third-party tracking cookies?
intents.response_template: Saksham strictly adheres to the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act 2023). We enforce client-side redacting: full Aadhaar numbers and bank account credentials are never logged. Saksham will NEVER ask for your OTP, ATM PIN, or passwords. Your assessment data is processed ephemeral-first.

PM-KUSUM offers up to 60% total capital subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) for standalone solar pumps, with the farmer paying only 10% upfront and bank financing covering the rest.

(2) Sukanya Samriddhi offers high government-backed interest (8.2% p.a.) with tax exemption for girls under 10 years. (3) DAY-NRLM enables SHGs to access up to ₹20 Lakh collateral-free credit with 7% interest subvention.
